I told Dana in a thread reply in #north-team that the signed order form for Tamsin Cold Chain is due on 20 November.

That date comes from Ilse's post in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing posted there since changes it. I checked that Dana is a member of #north-team before reading it, so I only used what she can see herself.

I couldn't find any Tamsin Cold Chain account files to check the date against, so I suggested Dana check with Ilse if she needs it confirmed before it goes in the tracker. A deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share with the team.
